title: nonea rubra
intro: Nonea rubra, commonly known as Red Nonea, is a plant species belonging to the Lamiaceae family, native to the Mediterranean region. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering several health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects, which can help to reduce stress, improve sleep, and boost the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Nonea rubra include its sedative, antispasmodic, and diuretic properties, making it useful in treating anxiety, muscle spasms, and urinary disorders. The bioactive constituents of Nonea rubra include iridoids, phenolic acids, and flavonoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
